body.en:
Question B-006-013-004.

Why the correct answer is right: For a quad driven loop, use 306 / f(MHz). 306 / 14.3 = 21.40 m.

Per-choice notes:
- sourceIndex 0: "21.40 metres": Correct. 306 divided by 14.3 rounds to 21.40 metres.
- sourceIndex 1: "10.49 metres": This is about half of the needed loop perimeter.
- sourceIndex 2: "16.36 metres": This is too short for the one-wavelength loop estimate.
- sourceIndex 3: "5.35 metres": This is about a quarter of the loop perimeter, not the total driven element length.
